blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Combining pretrained models is a common strategy for building AI systems, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model or merging fine-tuned checkpoints. However, finding compatible pairs typically requires costly empirical search, as compatibility is known only after alignment or merging. We propose COMPASS (COMPatibility ASsessment Score), a theoretically motivated diagnostic that estimates whether a model pair will be compatible prior to alignment or merging. Building on the observation that representational convergence is most robust at the level of local neighborhoods, COMPASS decomposes model compatibility into two cheap-to-compute axes: a pair-specific ease, defined as the $k$-NN overlap between the two encoders, and a paradigm-level ceiling, capturing the maximum overlap their training paradigms allow. Together, these two axes provide a ranking of candidate model pairs and prescribe how to act on each pair: (i) prioritize pairs that already agree and whose paradigms are compatible, (ii) invest additional compute on pairs with compatible paradigms but low initial agreement, (iii) switch the pretraining paradigm when it cannot support sufficient agreement, or (iv) deprioritize pairs that score poorly on both axes. We apply COMPASS to $72$ cross-modal alignment experiments and $392$ task-arithmetic model merges and show that compatibility estimates by COMPASS strongly correlate with downstream success, achieving average Pearson correlation of $0.91$ on cross-modal alignment tasks and $0.70$ on model merging.
blocks.zh: 结合预先训练过的模型是构建AI系统的共同战略,无论是通过将视觉编码器与语言模型相配合还是合并微调的检查站. 然而,寻找相容配对通常需要昂贵的经验性搜索,因为相容性只有在对齐或合并后才能被知道. 我们提出COMPASS(COMPatibility Assessment Score),这是一种理论上有动机的诊断,在对齐或合并之前估计一对模型是否相容. 基于代表式趋同在当地街区一级最强的观察,COMPASS将模型相容性分解为两个廉价相通轴:一对特异性易取,被定义为两个编码器之间的$k$-NN相接;一是范式级上限,捕捉出它们的培训范式允许的最大相接性. 这两个轴共同提供了候选模式对等的排名,并规定了如何对每对模式采取行动: (一)对已经同意且其范式相容的对等进行优先排序; (二)对具有相容范式但初始协议较低的对等进行额外计算; (三)在无法支持足够协议时切换预训范式; (四)对在两轴上得分不佳的对等进行优先排序. 我们把COMPAS应用于72美元跨模式对接试验和392美元任务-算术模型的合并,并表明COMPAS的相容性估计与下游的成功密切相关,在跨模式对接任务方面实现了平均Pearson的0.91美元和在模型合并方面达到了0.70美元。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Combining two pretrained models, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] or by merging two fine-tuned checkpoints into a single model [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] , is a central operation in modern transfer pipelines [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 7 , 11 ] .
In both cases, the most critical decision is which pair of models to combine. We treat both operations as instances of model-pair compatibility : the degree of agreement two pretrained models exhibit when aligned or merged. While prior works have proposed transferability metrics for selecting a single pretrained model for fine-tuning [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] , the analogous question for model pairs ( i.e. , whether two pretrained models will combine well) is typically answered only after expensive alignment or merging. A diagnostic that ranks candidate pairs from a small probe set, scoring each model once and reusing these scores across candidate pairs, could avoid most of these runs, reducing evaluation cost from scaling with the number of pairs to scaling with the number of models.
blocks.zh:
结合两个预训模式,无论是通过将一个视觉编码器与一个语言模式[1,2,3,4,5,6],还是将两个微调的检查站合并为一个单一模式[7,8,9,10],是现代转移管道[1,2,3,7,11]的中心操作.
在这两种情况下,最关键的决定是哪一种模式可以合并. 我们把这两种操作都当作模型-pair兼容性的例子:在对齐或合并时,两个预先训练过的模型的一致程度。 虽然以往的作品为选择一个单一的经过预先训练的模型进行微调[12,13,14]提出了可转移性衡量标准,但模型对的类似问题(即两个经过预先训练的模型是否会很好地结合)通常只有在经过昂贵的调整或合并后才能得到回答。 一种诊断从一个小的探针集中将候选对对进行排名,对每个模型评分一次,并在候选对对之间重新使用这些分数,可以避免这些跑步的大部分,从而降低评价成本,从对对数缩放到模型数缩放.

blocks.en:
A growing body of empirical work suggests that such a diagnostic could be achievable.
The Platonic Representation Hypothesis [ 15 ] suggested that sufficiently expressive models converge toward a shared global representation, whereas the Aristotelian Representation Hypothesis [ 16 ] showed that the agreement is mainly local: models trained with different objectives and data agree on who is close to whom , even when their global geometries differ, which makes it a natural candidate for a diagnostic. However, there is still a gap between this principle and a working model compatibility diagnostic.
blocks.zh:
越来越多的经验工作表明,这种诊断是可以实现的。
《柏拉图代表假说》[15] 指出,充分表达模式趋同于共同的全球代表制,而《阿里斯托德代表假说》[16] 则表明协议主要是本地的:受过不同目标和数据培训的模型都同意谁与谁关系密切,即使其全球地理美因不同,这使它成为诊断的自然候选者。 然而,这一原则与工作模式兼容性诊断之间仍存在差距。

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Given a library of candidate encoders, the compatibility of a model pair is typically unknown before running the downstream transfer.
Using COMPASS , we estimate the compatibility based on local neighborhood agreement: for each probe sample, we compare its local k k -NN overlap across the two representation spaces.
Aggregating this local overlap across different axes gives two scores computed before alignment or merging. Ease is a pair-specific score that measures how close the selected pair is at the start of the relevant dynamics: before encoder training in cross-modal alignment, and before weight merging in task arithmetic. Ceiling is a paradigm-level score that estimates how much agreement the corresponding training paradigms can support on average.
Candidate pairs are ranked by combining ease and ceiling.
Each axis is thresholded at its median value: green compatibility scores are above the corresponding median while the red ones are below it.
The resulting high/low pattern assigns each pair to one of four regimes: act now (high ease, high ceiling), budget-limited (low ease, high ceiling), ceiling-limited (high ease, low ceiling), or incompatible (low ease, low ceiling).
blocks.zh:
图1:鉴于一个候选编码器的库,在运行下游传输前,一个模型对的兼容性通常未知.
使用COMPAS,我们根据本地邻居协议来估计兼容性:对于每个探测样本,我们比较其本地kk-NN重叠在两个代表空间.
将不同轴的这种局部重叠加在一起,在对齐或合并之前可以计算出两个分数。 Ease是一对特异性的分数,在相关动态的开始时衡量所选对子的接近程度:在交叉模式对齐的编码器训练之前,在任务算术中的重量合并之前. 上限是一个范式级别的分数,估计相应的培训范式平均能支持多少一致.
考生对的排名是结合便捷性和上限排列的.
每个轴按其中位值设定阈值:绿色兼容分数高于相应的中位数,而红色的则低于中位数.
由此产生的高/低模式将每一对配给四个制度中的一个:现在行动(高易度,高上限),预算限制(低易度,高上限),上限限制(高易度,低上限),或者不相容(低易度,低上限).

blocks.en:
Here, we close the gap and give a theoretical motivation for why local overlap should predict model-pair compatibility. Motivated by this, we introduce COMPASS (COMPatibility ASsessment Score), a diagnostic that combines two cheap-to-compute axes ( Figure 1 ). The first axis, the ease score, asks: How much agreement does a pair exhibit before any training?
Pairs that already agree on local neighborhoods need only modest training for them to locally agree, whereas pairs with low initial agreement require substantially more training.
The second axis, the ceiling score, asks: How much agreement can the training paradigms of model pairs support in general before training, averaged across models drawn from those paradigms?
Paradigms with very different training objectives ( e.g. , reconstructive vs. autoregressive) exhibit limited agreement, regardless of how well aligned the pair is.
blocks.zh:
在这里,我们缩小差距,给出一个理论动机,说明为什么局部重叠应该预测模型-pair兼容性. 以此为动力,我们引入了COMPASS(COMPatibility Assessment Score),这种诊断结合了两个廉价到计算轴(图1). 第一轴"易"分数 问:一对展品在任何训练前有多少协议?.
已经就当地邻里问题达成一致的对等条件仅需要适度的培训,以便他们在当地达成一致,而最初协议较低的对等条件则需要更多的培训。
第二轴 天花板分数 问: 模式对等的培训模式在培训之前能普遍支持多少共识? 平均而言,这些模式对不同的模式具有影响。
具有非常不同培训目标的范式(如重建式与自动递减式)显示的一致程度有限,而不论对齐程度如何。

blocks.en:
We combine ease and ceiling multiplicatively to obtain the continuous COMPASS score, which ranks candidate pairs by favoring those that are strong on both axes. For interpretability, thresholding each axis at its median gives a phase diagram that groups candidate pairs into four regimes: act now (high ease, high ceiling), budget-limited (low ease, high ceiling), ceiling-limited (high ease, low ceiling), and incompatible (low ease, low ceiling).
Act-now pairs are the strongest immediate candidates, and their transfer is expected to be both feasible and efficient.
For budget-limited pairs, the success may require more data, optimization, or a stronger partner.
For ceiling-limited pairs, one should switch to a paradigm whose target is closer to the downstream target.
Incompatible pairs are weak on both axes and should be deprioritized.
The regimes summarize the ranking; the continuous score remains the primary output.
blocks.zh:
我们以多种方式将方便和上限结合起来,以获得连续的COMPAS分数,该分数通过优待两个轴上强者来对候选人对等进行排名。 就可解释性而言,将每一轴的中位阈值给出一个相位图,将候选对子分为四个制度:现在行动(高易度,高上限度),预算限制(低易度,高上限度),上限限制(高易度,低上限度)和不相容(低易度,低上限度).
现成双人是最强的即时候选人,预计他们的调动既可行又有效。
对于预算有限的对子,成功可能需要更多的数据,优化,或者更强大的伙伴.
对于受上限限制的对子,人们应该转向一个其目标更接近下游目标的模式.
不相容的对子在两轴上都是弱的,应当取消优先级.
这些制度总结了排名;连续得分仍然是主要产出。

blocks.en: We evaluate COMPASS in two applications: cross-modal alignment and task-arithmetic merging. In cross-modal alignment, we consider 72 72 vision-language pairs and show that COMPASS predicts retrieval R@1 with Pearson correlation of 0.90 0.90 on the Flickr30k dataset [ 17 ] and 0.91 0.91 on the COCO dataset [ 18 ] , compared to the Pearson correlation of 0.63 0.63 and 0.68 0.68 for global CKA [ 19 ] . In task-arithmetic merging, we consider 392 392 task pairs from 14 14 ViT checkpoints fine-tuned on the 8 8 image-classification tasks from the standard task-arithmetic benchmark [ 11 ] . COMPASS predicts mean retention across the 8 8 image-classification tasks with Pearson correlation of 0.70 0.70 , compared to 0.25 0.25 for global CKA [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们评价COMPAS的两种应用方式:跨模式对接和任务-算术合并。 在跨模式对齐中,我们考虑72对72对视觉语言对齐,并显示COMPAS预测R@1与皮尔逊相关联在Flickr30k数据集上为0.90 0.90,COCO数据集上为0.91 0.91,相比之下皮尔逊相关联在全球CKA上为0.63 0.63和0.68 0.68[19]. 在任务-数学合并中,我们认为从标准任务-数学基准[11]对14个ViT检查站的392 392个任务对8个图像分类任务进行了微调。 COMPAS预测在8个图像分类任务中,Pearson相关值为0.70 0.70,而全球CKA[19]为0.25 0.25。

blocks.en: Contributions. (i) We introduce COMPASS , a diagnostic for selecting model pairs before expensive alignment or merging, combining a pair-specific ease score with a paradigm-level ceiling score. (ii) We provide a supporting analysis on how quickly the two models will become better aligned, given how close they start, and on a bound that says how close two models’ local neighborhoods can ever get, given their training paradigms. (iii) We validate COMPASS across cross-modal alignment and task-arithmetic merging, demonstrating that it strongly correlates with downstream transfer success and reliably ranks candidate pairs before transfer.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 (i) 我们引入COMPAS, 即在昂贵的对齐或合并之前选择模型对子的诊断,将对偶的易分和范式等级上限分合并。 (二) 我们提供一种支持性的分析,说明两种模式将如何快速地变得更加一致,因为这两个模式的起点有多接近,以及两个模式的本地邻居根据其培训模式能够如何接近。 (三) 我们验证COMPAS的跨模式调整和任务-模拟合并,表明它与下游转让的成功密切相关,在转让前对候选人的对等进行可靠排名。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Representational convergence. Representational convergence studies whether independently trained models recover similar structure in their learned representations.
Early evidence showed that different networks trained on the same task learn similar features [ 20 ] and that representations from different networks can often be stitched together [ 21 ] , suggesting shared structure across independently trained models.
At the scale of foundation models, the Platonic Representation Hypothesis [ 15 ] proposed that sufficiently broad and capable models may converge toward a shared representation. The Aristotelian Representation Hypothesis [ 16 ] questioned this global view and showed that only local neighborhood alignment can be empirically observed. Gupta et al. [22] demonstrated strong convergence within CLIP-style architectures.
Together, these works provide growing empirical evidence that representational convergence is real but more often local than global.
We build on this view but shift the focus from observation to application by using local agreement of trained models to select suitable model pairs for alignment and merging.
blocks.zh:
代表性趋同. 代表性的趋同研究 独立训练的模型是否在其学习的表示中恢复了类似的结构.
早期证据表明,接受过同一任务培训的不同网络学习了相似的特征[20],不同网络的表述往往可以被缝合[21],建议跨独立培训的模型共享结构.
在基础模型的规模上,柏拉图代表假说[15]建议,足够广泛和有能力的模型可以趋同到共同代表。 Aristotelian代表假说[16]质疑这一全球观点,并表明只有当地街区的配合才能在经验上被观察. Gupta等人[22]在CLIP风格的建筑中表现出强烈的趋同.
这些著作共同提供了越来越多的实证证据,表明代表性的趋同是真实的,但往往是地方性的而不是全球性的。
我们以这一观点为基础,但将重点从观察转向应用,利用当地对训练有素的模型的同意来选择合适的模型对,用于对齐和合并.

blocks.en:
Structure of training objectives. Training objectives shape the geometry of learned representations by specifying the conditional relationships that the model is trained to learn.
This makes them central to model compatibility: two models trained with similar objectives may induce similar neighborhoods, whereas models trained with different objectives may preserve different notions of similarity.
The I-Con framework [ 23 ] unified contrastive, non-contrastive, and clustering objectives by minimizing Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence over conditional distributions.
We use this view to connect objective-level similarity to local representational agreement.
If two training paradigms induce similar neighborhood structure, their representations can support higher local agreement; if they induce different neighborhoods, downstream transfer is limited even before optimization begins.
This motivates our paradigm-level ceiling score, which estimates how much local agreement a pair of training paradigms can support.
blocks.zh:
培训目标的结构。 培训目标通过具体说明该模型所训练的学习条件关系,来塑造所学表现的几何特征.
这使得它们成为模型兼容性的核心:两个接受过类似目标培训的模型可能诱发类似的邻里,而接受过不同目标培训的模型则可能保留不同的相似性概念.
I-Con框架[23]通过尽量减少Kullback-Leibler(KL)在有条件分配上的分歧,实现统一的对比性,非冲突性,以及集群目标.
我们利用这种观点将目标层面的类似程度与当地代表协议联系起来。
如果两个培训范式会诱导类似的邻里结构,其代表可以支持更高的本地协议;如果它们诱导不同的邻里,即使优化开始前下游转移也是有限的.
这激发了我们的范式水平上限分数,估计一对培训范式可以支持多少地方协议.

blocks.en:
Multi-modal alignment. Multi-modal alignment aims to map representations from different modalities into a shared space where semantically corresponding inputs are close [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
A central difficulty is that different modalities may retain distinct geometry even after alignment. Liang et al. [24] identified such a persistent “modality gap” in CLIP representations, showing that image and text embeddings occupy distinct regions of the shared space even after contrastive training.
Most work on alignment focuses on improving the alignment method [ 4 , 5 ] or reducing the amount of paired data required for alignment [ 25 , 6 ] .
Our goal is complementary; we provide a pre-alignment diagnostic for model selection.
We show that local k k -NN overlap is cheap to compute on a probe set, suggesting which frozen encoder pairs are worth aligning before expensive training is run.
blocks.zh:
多式联运对接。 多式联运组合旨在将不同模式的表示图映射到一个共享空间中,该空间的对应投入接近[1、2、3]。
一个中心困难是,即使在对齐之后,不同的模式也可能保留不同的几何特征。 梁等编. [24] 在CLIP表述中确定了这种持续存在的“模式差距”,表明即使经过对比性培训,图像和文字嵌入也占据了共享空间的不同区域。
大多数关于对齐的工作侧重于改进对齐方法[4,5]或减少对齐所需的对齐数据[25,6].
我们的目标是相互补充的;我们为模型的选择提供预先调整的诊断。
显示本地的 k -NN 重叠在探测器组上是便宜的, 说明在进行昂贵的训练之前, 哪些冷冻的编码器对是值得调整的。

blocks.en:
Weight-space transfer and model merging. Model merging combines multiple trained models directly in weight space, with the goal of reusing their capabilities without training a new model from scratch.
Examples include model soups [ 7 ] , which average fine-tuned weights, task arithmetic [ 11 ] , which edits behavior via weight-space task vectors, and evolutionary merging [ 10 ] , which searches over merging recipes across tasks.
These methods are most effective when checkpoints being combined remain compatible; otherwise, averaging can interpolate into a region that preserves neither model well.
Existing merging approaches typically discover this only after performing the merge and evaluating the result [ 7 , 11 , 10 ] .
In contrast, we study whether mergeability can be estimated beforehand.
For two fine-tuned checkpoints, we measure whether they agree on local neighborhoods and use this agreement to predict merge quality before actual model merging.
blocks.zh:
重量空间转移与模型合并. 模型合并将多个训练有素的模型直接结合在重量空间中,目标是在不从零开始训练新模型的情况下重新使用它们的能力.
例子包括模型汤[7],平均微调重量,任务算术[11],通过重空任务矢量编辑行为,进化合并[10],在任务之间搜索合并食谱.
在检查站合并后,这些方法最为有效;否则,平均会渗透到一个既不能很好地保存模式的区域。
现有的合并办法通常只有在进行合并和评估结果之后才发现这一点[7、11、10]。
相反,我们研究是否可以事先估计合并的可能性。
对于两个经过精细调整的检查站,我们衡量它们是否就当地街区达成一致,并利用这项协议预测合并的质量,然后才能实际的模型合并.

blocks.en: 3 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en: We measure agreement using local k k -NN overlap, the fraction of nearest neighbors that two encoders share for each sample. Gröger et al. [16] showed that representational convergence persists across architectures and modalities at the level of local neighborhoods, while global agreement is not observed. Appendix D confirms that, on our model library, local overlap correlates with downstream transfer more strongly than global agreement ( e.g. , CKA [ 19 ] ) does.
blocks.zh: 我们用本地 kk - NN 重叠来测量协议, 即每个样本的两个编码器共享的最近邻居的一小部分 。 Gröger等人著. [16] 表明,在地方街区一级,代表性的趋同在结构和模式上一直存在,而全球协议没有得到遵守。 附 录 D确认,在我们的模式库中,地方重叠与下游转移的关系比全球协议(如CKA[19])更密切。

blocks.en: 4 Theoretical motivation
blocks.zh: 4 理论动机

blocks.en:
We motivate COMPASS through sufficient conditions under which local overlap is
informative for compatibility. Theorem 4.1 connects start-condition overlap to
finite-budget convergence, motivating ease ; Theorem 4.2 connects target
discrepancy to achievable overlap, motivating ceiling . These results provide
supporting motivation rather than universal guarantees; assumptions and failure
modes are discussed in Appendix A and Section F.1 .

blocks.en: The bound motivates using per-sample start-condition overlap as the pair-specific ease score: it is measurable before any joint optimization, and higher values reduce the initial inter-model gap δ i ( 0 ) = ( 1 − ε ) ​ ( 1 − o i ( 0 ) ) \delta_{i}^{(0)}=(1-\varepsilon)(1-o_{i}^{(0)}) , thereby tightening the finite-time guarantee. Pairs with higher per-sample start-condition overlap are therefore easier to make compatible within a fixed training budget.
blocks.zh: 捆绑的动机是将每个样板的起始条件重叠作为对偶特定的便捷分数:在任何联合优化前都是可测量的,更高的值会减少初始的模组间差距 i i (0) = (1– ε) (1– o i (0))\ delta_{i }^{ (0) (1-\ varepsilon)(1-o_{i}^{(0))),从而收紧了限定时间的保证. 因此,在固定的培训预算范围内,每件样本起始条件重叠较多的对价更容易兼容。

blocks.en:
In practice, the start-condition overlap is the per-sample overlap measured at the start of the relevant training dynamics, o i ( 0 ) o_{i}^{(0)} , which differs by setting.
In unimodal convergence, the dynamics goes from a random initialization to the pretrained model, so the per-sample start-condition overlap is the per-sample overlap between two random initializations of the architecture.
In cross-modal alignment, the dynamics goes from the two frozen pretrained models to the trained adapter, so the per-sample start-condition overlap is the pretrained per-sample overlap between those models.
In task-arithmetic merging, the dynamics start from the two fine-tuned checkpoints to their weight-averaged combination, so the per-sample start-condition overlap is the per-sample overlap between the two checkpoints. Figure 2 shows the per-sample start-condition overlap against the corresponding endpoint across different settings.
blocks.zh:
在实践中,起始条件重叠是相关训练动态开始时测量的每个样本重叠,o i (0) o_{i}^{(0)},这因设置而有所不同.
在单模式趋同中,动力学从随机初始化到预先训练的模型,因此每个样板起始条件的重叠是结构的两个随机初始化之间的每个样板重叠.
在跨模式对齐中,动力学从两个被冻结的预先训练的模型发展到经过训练的适配器,所以每个样板起始条件的重叠就是这些模型之间的预先训练的每个样板重叠.
在任务-数学合并中,动态从两个微调的检查站开始到它们平均重量的组合,因此每个样例的起始条件重叠是两个样例的重复. 图2显示不同设置的每个抽样起始条件与相应终点的重叠。

blocks.en: 4.2 Paradigm-level ceiling: target discrepancy
blocks.zh: 4.2 标准水平上限:目标差异

blocks.en: We now look into the paradigm-level component of compatibility. Even if two models start from a favorable pair-specific per-sample start-condition overlap, their training objectives [ 23 ] ( e.g. , contrastive, reconstructive, self-distillation) may result in different neighborhoods. Such disagreement limits the per-sample overlap that the two representations can support, independently of the finite training budget. We formalize this obstruction through a target-discrepancy term and show that it determines the paradigm-level ceiling used in COMPASS .
blocks.zh: 我们现在研究兼容性的范式层面的组成部分。 即使两个模型从一个有利的对偶特异性的每样起始条件重叠开始,他们的训练目标[23](如对比性,重建性,自我消化)也可能导致不同的邻里. 这种分歧限制了两个代表可以支持的每个样本的重叠,而不考虑有限的培训预算。 我们通过目标差异术语正式确定这种障碍,并表明它决定了COMPAS中使用的范式级别上限。

blocks.en: 4.3 Implications from combining ease and ceiling
blocks.zh: 4.3 将便捷性和上限结合起来所产生的影响

blocks.en: Together, Theorem 4.1 and Theorem 4.2 motivate complementary finite-budget and achievable agreement components of compatibility.
blocks.zh: 定理4.1和定理4.2共同激发了互补的有限预算和可实现的协议的兼容性组成部分。

blocks.en:
The event in Theorem 4.1 has two parts: at least one model reaches its target within tolerance ξ \xi , and the two models remain within gap η \eta of each other. If the two models X X and Y Y share the same target q ⋆ ( ⋅ ∣ i ) q^{\star}(\cdot\mid i) , then the triangle inequality implies that both models are within ξ + η \xi+\eta of this shared target. More generally, when the targets differ, if model X X , for example, is within ξ \xi of its target, then model Y Y is within ξ + η \xi+\eta of model X X ’s target and within ξ + η + γ i \xi+\eta+\gamma_{i} of its own target, where γ i \gamma_{i} is the target discrepancy defined in Equation 5 . Thus, start-condition overlap controls the
finite-time probability of reaching a common neighborhood structure, while any
mismatch between the targets appears as an additional obstruction.
The bound increases strictly in the per-sample start-condition overlap o i ( 0 ) o_{i}^{(0)} , so pairs that start with more shared neighbors have a tighter finite-time guarantee.

blocks.en: The pair-specific ease and paradigm-level ceiling scores together provide a measure of model compatibility for the two applications we consider: (i) cross-modal alignment, and (ii) model merging. We combine them into a simple diagnostic recipe, COMPASS (COMPatibility ASsessment Score), which ranks candidate model pairs before any transfer is performed. Both quantities are inexpensive to compute, requiring only forward passes over a small probe set.
blocks.zh: 组合式的简单度和范式级别的上限分数加在一起,为我们所考虑的两个应用提供了模型兼容性的尺度:(一) 跨模式对齐,(二) 模型合并。 我们把它们合并成一个简单的诊断药方,COMPASS(COMPatibility Assessment Score),在进行任何转会之前对候选的模型配对进行排名. 这两种数量都低廉的计算,只需通过小型探测器即可。

blocks.en:
The probe set should be drawn from the relevant data distribution, i.e. , image-text pairs for cross-modal alignment (where the diagnostic measures vision-text agreement) and task-relevant images for merging fine-tuned checkpoints (where it measures agreement between models specialized to those tasks).
In practice, we use 1024 1024 image-text pairs from WIT [ 26 ] for alignment, and a 2048 2048 -sample probe pooled from one of the eight fine-tuning tasks for merging, here MNIST [ 27 ] ( Section H.3 ablates the choice).
blocks.zh:
探测器集应从相关数据分布中抽取,即用于跨模式对齐的图像文本配对(其中的诊断措施是视觉文本协议)和用于合并经过微调的检查站的任务相关图像(其中测量专门用于这些任务的模型之间的协议)。
在实践中,我们使用来自WIT[26]的1024 1024个图像文本对对对对对对对对对对对对对对对对对,以及从合并的八项微调任务之一集合的2048 2048个样本探测器,这里是MNIST[27](H.3节放弃了选择)。

blocks.en: Candidate pairs are ranked by the product of ease and ceiling scores. Importantly, feature extraction scales with the number of models rather than candidate pairs. For the 19 × 10 19\times 10 alignment grid, COMPASS requires only 29 probe passes instead of 190 downstream alignment runs. In our setup, this translates to more than two orders of magnitude lower wall-clock cost, with full timing details reported in Section H.10 .
blocks.zh: 考生对分按易和上限分数的产品排名. 重要的是,以模型数量而不是候选对数为特征提取尺度。 对于19×10 19\\Times 10对齐网格,COMPAS只需要29个探测器通过,而不是190次下游对齐运行. 在我们的设置中,这意味着墙上小时费用降低两个以上数量级,H.10节报告了全部计时细节。

blocks.en:
COMPASS: Model compatibility diagnostic. Given a library of candidate models and a way to combine them ( e.g. , cross-modal alignment or task-arithmetic model merging): 1. Compute ease and ceiling on the probe set. Ease is the pair-specific k k -NN overlap measured at the start of the relevant training dynamics. Ceiling is a paradigm-level mean k k -NN overlap that estimates the upper bound on agreement the two paradigms can support.
Both scores lie in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ; higher score is better. 2. Rank pairs by the product of ease and ceiling. Produce ranking of pairs by combining ease and ceiling scores. Pairs with higher scores should be prioritized. 3. Read the quadrant as a fallback diagnostic. Splitting each axis at its median yields four regimes: (i) act now (high ease, high ceiling), (ii) budget-limited (low ease, high ceiling), (iii) ceiling-limited (high ease, low ceiling), and (iv) incompatible (low ease, low ceiling). For budget-limited , invest in more data, optimization, or a stronger partner. For ceiling-limited , switch to a paradigm whose target is closer to the downstream target. Deprioritize incompatible pairs.
blocks.zh:
COMPAS:模型兼容性诊断. 考虑到候选模型的库库和结合这些模型的方法(例如,跨模式对接或任务-数学模型合并): 1. 计算探测器的易度和上限。 Ease是相关培训动态开始时测得的对称特异性kk-NN重叠. 上限是一个范式级的平均值 k - NN 重叠,它估计了两个范式可以支持的协议上的上限.
两个分数都位于[0,1] [0,1];分数较高更好. 2. 由易和天花板制成的排名对。 通过将易和天花板分数相结合,产生对数的排名. 分数较高的对等应优先排序. 3. 读四角体作为倒置诊断. 按中位数划分每个轴线可产生四个制度:(一) 现时行动(高易度、高上限);(二) 预算有限(低易度、高上限);(三) 上限有限(高易度、低上限);(四) 不相容(低易度、低上限)。 对于预算有限的,投资更多的数据,优化,或更强大的伙伴. 对于上限限制,切换到目标更接近下游目标的范式. 离诸不相对.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 compares the correlation between candidate predictors and the downstream outcome in cross-modal alignment and model merging via task arithmetic. In cross-modal alignment, we measure the downstream outcome as image-to-text Recall@1 (R@1) after training a CSA adapter, evaluated on Flickr30k and COCO datasets.
The product ease × \times ceiling reaches Pearson correlation of | r | = 0.90 |r|=0.90 with R@1 on the Flickr30k I2T dataset and | r | = 0.91 |r|=0.91 with R@1 on the COCO I2T dataset, compared to 0.84 / 0.83 0.84/0.83 for ease alone and 0.85 / 0.83 0.85/0.83 for ceiling alone, respectively.
In task-arithmetic model merging, we measure the downstream outcome as the mean of per-task accuracy retained relative to the unmerged checkpoints after weight averaging, evaluated across 392 task-pair merges from 14 pretrained ViT backbones spanning five pretraining paradigms.
The product ease × \times ceiling reaches | r | = 0.70 |r|=0.70 with merge quality, compared to 0.67 0.67 for ease alone and 0.64 0.64 for ceiling alone.
Global CKA, in contrast, correlates only weakly with downstream outcomes in both applications ( 0.63 / 0.68 0.63/0.68 for alignment, 0.25 0.25 for merging).

blocks.en: Because the practical goal is model selection, we next ask whether this advantage is preserved at the level of pair rankings. We compare COMPASS with the alternative predictors using Spearman ρ \rho and Kendall τ \tau . COMPASS remains the strongest predictor, reaching Spearman ρ = 0.91 / 0.93 \rho=0.91/0.93 on Flickr30k/COCO and 0.70 0.70 for merging; full results are reported in Section H.6 . Under budgeted evaluation, COMPASS finds the optimal alignment pair immediately and the optimal merge within the first 5 of 392 candidates ( Section H.6 ).
blocks.zh: 由于实际目标是模型选择,我们接下来询问这一优势是否保留在对位排名的水平. 我们用 Spearman ^\rho 和 Kendall →\tau 来比较COMPAS 和 替代预测器。 COMPAS仍然是最强的预测器,在Flickr30k/COCO上达到Spearman ± 0.91/0.93 = 0.91/0.93,合并后达到0.70/0.70;H.6节报告了全部结果。 在编入预算的评价下,COMPAS立即找到最佳配对,并在392名候选人的前5名中找到最佳合并(H.6节)。

blocks.en: We further test whether this advantage depends on the particular set of predictors considered in Figure 3 . Comparisons with metadata predictors, alternative representational similarities, and learned metadata regressors are reported in Section H.7 . COMPASS outperforms the baselines computed before alignment or merging; learned regressors can perform strongly when trained on completed alignment or merging outcomes, but degrade under held-out families or paradigms.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步检验这一优势是否取决于图3中考虑的特定一套预测器。 H.7节报告了与元数据预测器的比较、替代性代表性相似性以及学到的元数据倒退器。 COMPAS比在调整或合并之前计算的基线要好;学习的退步者在接受关于完成调整或合并结果的培训时可以发挥强有力的作用,但在被搁置的家庭或范式下却会退化。

blocks.en:
Cross-modal alignment trains a learned adapter on paired image-text data so that a frozen vision encoder and a frozen language model produce compatible representations [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
Following the setup of Gröger et al. [6] , we connect the two encoders with a small learned adapter (CSA [ 25 ] ) trained on MS-COCO [ 18 ] dataset.
Downstream performance is measured on two retrieval benchmarks Flickr30k [ 17 ] and COCO [ 18 ] datasets using image-to-text R@1 after alignment.
We evaluate 72 72 vision-language pairs spanning 19 19 vision models ( 6 6 paradigm families) and 10 10 text encoders ( 7 7 families); see Section B.1 for the full library.
blocks.zh:
跨模式对接在成对图像文本数据上训练一个已学习到的适配器,这样一个冷冻的视觉编码器和一个冷冻的语言模型就会产生兼容的表示[1,2,3,4,5,6].
在格勒格等人建立之后. [6],我们将两个编码器与一个受过MS-COCO[18]数据集培训的小型学习适配器(CSA[25])连接起来.
下游的性能通过两个检索基准Flickr30k[17]和COCO[18]数据集在对齐后使用图像到文本的R@1.
我们评估了72个72个视觉语言配对,涉及19个视觉模式(6个典型家庭)和10个文本编码器(7个家庭);完整的图书馆见B.1节。

blocks.en: For alignment, ease is the pretrained cross-modal k k -NN overlap of the vision-text pair, while ceiling averages the vision encoder’s overlap across the reference language-model library; both are measured on the 1024-sized subset from WIT as in [ 15 ] before any alignment training ( Section B.1.4 ). Intuitively, a vision paradigm whose pretraining target is already linked to language (contrastive vision-language) has a high ceiling, whereas one whose target is pixel reconstruction (masked autoencoding) has a low ceiling.
blocks.zh: 对于对齐,方便是视觉文本对齐的预先训练的交叉模式 k k - NN 重叠,而上限平均是视觉编码器在参考语言模型库中的重叠;在任何对齐训练之前,均按WIT的1024大小子集进行测量(B.1.4节)。 直觉上,一个视觉范式,其预训目标已经与语言(contrastic vision-language)相连,其上限很高,而一个目标是像素重建(masked autoencoding),其上限较低.

blocks.en:
The ease axis separates pairs whose frozen encoders already agree on neighborhoods from those that do not.
The ceiling axis separates contrastive vision-language paradigms (CLIP 0.140 0.140 , SigLIP 0.134 0.134 ) from CLIP fine-tuned ( 0.112 0.112 ), self-distillation ( 0.109 0.109 ), discriminative ( 0.100 0.100 ), and reconstructive ( 0.058 0.058 ). Figure 4 shows the resulting phase diagram for both retrieval benchmarks; the quadrant structure is consistent across both.
Mean Flickr30k I2T R@1 separates the regimes cleanly: act now ( n = 28 n=28 ) reaches 0.46 ± 0.09 0.46\pm 0.09 , ceiling-limited ( n = 8 n=8 ) 0.34 ± 0.05 0.34\pm 0.05 , budget-limited ( n = 10 n=10 ) 0.30 ± 0.06 0.30\pm 0.06 , and incompatible ( n = 26 n=26 ) 0.21 ± 0.11 0.21\pm 0.11 , with the same ordering on COCO.
A Kruskal–Wallis test [ 28 ] rejects the null that the four regimes share the same R@1 distribution (Flickr30k: H = 45.3 H=45.3 , p < 10 − 9 p<10^{-9} ; COCO: H = 51.5 H=51.5 , p < 10 − 10 p<10^{-10} ). Section H.5 reports the full per-regime distribution.
Contrastive vision-language paradigms (CLIP, SigLIP, CLIP-FT) and the largest DINOv2 variants populate act now , reaching up to 63 % 63\% Flickr R@1; smaller DINOv2 and ImageNet-21K models fall into ceiling-limited ; MAE (mean Flickr R@1 0.11 0.11 , range 5 5 - 24 % 24\% ) along with the smallest ImageNet-21K and DINOv2 models occupy incompatible . The unusually low-overlap cases associated with the SigLIP text tower are analyzed in Section H.13 .

blocks.en: We next test whether this relationship is driven by coarse differences between model families or by details of the alignment setup. First, ease remains predictive when the vision-model family is held fixed: within each of the six vision families, ease correlates positively with R@1 across the text partners, with a median Spearman ρ = 0.80 \rho=0.80 ( Section H.11 ), showing that its signal is not explained only by broad differences between pretraining paradigms. Second, the diagnostic tracks changes even within a fixed architecture: classification fine-tuning lowers the cross-modal ceiling at all three tested CLIP scales, with retrieval changing in the same direction ( Section H.12 ). Finally, the resulting pair ranking is not specific to CSA: on 24 representative pairs, COMPASS remains predictive under trained Linear, MLP, and LoRA-style adapters, and outperforms global CKA in each case ( Section H.9 ).
blocks.zh: 我们接下来要测试这种关系是由模范家庭之间的粗糙差异还是由组合设置的细节驱动的. 首先,在定住视觉模型家族时,便捷性仍然具有预测性:在六个视觉家族中,在六个视觉家族中,易易与R@1在文字伙伴之间有正相关,中位数Spearman ^ = 0.80\rho= 0.80(H.11节),表明其信号并非仅由预训范式之间的广泛差异来解释. 其次,诊断轨道甚至在固定架构内也会发生变化:分类微调降低了所有三个测试的CLIP比额表的跨模式上限,检索方向也发生变化(H.12节)。 最后,由此产生的配对排名并非特指加空局:在24对有代表性的配对上,COMPAS在训练有素的线性、MLP和LORA式适配器下仍然具有预测性,在每种情况下都超过了全球CKA(H.9节)。

blocks.en: The training-budget experiments further clarify the meaning of ceiling. Across 18 alignment pairs, its correlation with downstream performance increases from ρ = 0.79 \rho=0.79 after 10 epochs to 0.92 0.92 after 300 epochs, as low-ceiling pairs saturate while higher-ceiling pairs continue toward stronger outcomes ( Section H.14 ). Ceiling therefore captures the level of performance that a transfer setting can ultimately support, rather than the marginal improvement obtained from increasing the training budget over an arbitrary interval.
blocks.zh: 培训预算试验进一步澄清了上限的含义。 在18对对齐中,它与下游性能的关联性从10个纪元后=0.79\rho=0.79增加到300个纪元后的0.92 0.92,因为低升对齐饱和,而高升对齐则继续向更强劲的结果发展(H.14节)。 因此,最高比率记录了调动设置最终可以支持的绩效水平,而不是任意间隔增加培训预算所取得的微不足道的改进。

blocks.en: 5.2 COMPASS for task-arithmetic model merging
blocks.zh: 5.2 合并任务-数学模型的COMPASS

blocks.en:
Combining the weights of multiple fine-tuned models is a common alternative to joint multi-task training [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] .
We focus on the task arithmetic [ 11 ] : two checkpoints of the same base model, each fine-tuned on a different downstream task, are combined into a single model whose weights are the average of the two, with the goal of inheriting the capabilities of both.
The downstream metric is mean retention across the two original tasks after merging.
We fine-tune 14 14 models (9 ViT-B/16, 4 ViT-L/14-16, 1 ViT-T/16) from 5 5 pretraining paradigms on 8 8 tasks from the standard benchmark [ 11 ] and merge all within-paradigm pairs (392 model merges in total).
Details and the full task-arithmetic multi-task extension are in Section H.4 .
blocks.zh:
结合多个微调模型的权重,是联合多任务训练的常见替代[7,8,9,10].
我们注重任务算术[11]:两个同基模式的检查站,每个检查站根据不同的下游任务进行微调,合并成一个单一模式,其权重为两者的平均值,目标是继承两者的能力.
下游的衡量标准是合并后在两项原始任务之间保留。
我们从5个预训范式对14个14个型号(9个Vit-B/16,4个Vit-L/14-16,1个Vit-T/16)进行微调,从标准基准[11]中对8个任务的8个任务进行预训范式,并合并所有paradigm内配对(共392个型号合并).
H.4节载有细节和全部任务-数学多任务扩展。

blocks.en: For task-arithmetic merging, ease is the pre-merge k k -NN overlap between the two fine-tuned checkpoints, while ceiling measures specialization of their pretrained base model relative to the reference vision-model library ( Section B.1.4 ).
blocks.zh: 对于任务-数学合并,容易是两个经过微调的检查站之间预先出现的kk-NN重叠,而相对于参考视觉模型库(B.1.4节)而言,其预先训练的基础模型的上限计量专门化。

blocks.en: If the two checkpoints already agree on neighborhood structure, weight averaging is unlikely to interpolate destructively, consistent with the linear mode connectivity literature [ 29 , 30 ] ; whereas if they disagree, averaging interpolates into a region that neither checkpoint occupied. Specialized paradigms, such as those whose features differ most from other paradigms, produce smaller, more consistent task vectors under fine-tuning, so weight averaging drifts less.
blocks.zh: 如果两个检查站已经就邻里结构达成一致,平均重量不太可能与线性模式的连接文献[29,30]相接,从而产生破坏性;而如果两个检查站有分歧,平均重量则会渗透到一个没有检查站占据的地区。 专门的范式,如其特征与其他范式差异最大的范式,在微调下产生更小,更一致的任务矢量,因此重量平均漂移较少.

blocks.en:
The four regimes mirror those in Section 5.1 , applied to fine-tuned checkpoints rather than pretrained encoders.
Discriminative, self-distillation, and reconstructive paradigms populate the act now regime; the ceiling-limited and incompatible regimes concentrate on contrastive vision-language paradigms, whose features change substantially under classification fine-tuning.
Mean retention again separates the regimes cleanly (Kruskal–Wallis H = 198.2 H=198.2 , p < 10 − 42 p<10^{-42} ): act now ( n = 129 n=129 ) at 0.84 ± 0.16 0.84\pm 0.16 , budget-limited ( n = 67 n=67 ) at 0.57 ± 0.26 0.57\pm 0.26 , ceiling-limited ( n = 67 n=67 ) at 0.56 ± 0.23 0.56\pm 0.23 , and incompatible ( n = 129 n=129 ) at 0.35 ± 0.17 0.35\pm 0.17 ( Section H.5 ).
Budget-limited and ceiling-limited pairs reach almost the same mean retention ( 0.57 0.57 vs. 0.56 0.56 ), yet they call for different actions: more optimization or a stronger partner for the first, a different paradigm for the second. The regime label carries this distinction, the score alone does not.
blocks.zh:
这四个制度与第5.1节中的制度相似,适用于经过微调的检查站,而不是事先训练的编码器。
歧视性的、自我分散的、重建的范式现在充斥着这一行为制度;受上限限制的和不相容的制度集中于具有对比性的视觉语言范式,其特征在分类的微调下发生了很大变化。
平均保留再次将政权清洁区分开来(Kruskal-Wallis H=198.2 H=198.2,p < 10 - 42 p < 10 > - 42}):现在(n=129 n=129)0.84±0.16 0.84\pm0.16,预算限制(n=67 n=67)0.57\pm0.26,上限限制(n=67 n=67)0.56,0.56±0.26\pm0.23,不兼容(n=129 n=129)0.35±0.175\pm0.17(H.5节)。
受预算限制和受上限限制的对几乎达到相同的平均保留(0.57 0.57对0.56 0.56),然而它们要求不同的行动:对第一个更优化或更强的伙伴,对第二个更是不同的范式. 制度标签带有这种区别,单是得分就不行.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
In this work, we show that model-pair compatibility can be estimated before running an expensive transfer procedure.
A small probe set is enough to measure whether two models agree on local neighborhoods, and this local agreement provides a strong signal of downstream transfer success.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们表明,在进行昂贵的转让程序之前,模型-pair兼容性是可以估计的。
一个小型的探针集足以衡量两种模型是否就当地的街区达成一致,而这个地方协议提供了下游转移成功的强烈信号.

blocks.en:
The key idea is to separate compatibility into two parts. Ease measures whether a specific pair already starts close: it is high when the two encoders assign similar neighbors to the same examples before alignment or merging. Ceiling measures whether the corresponding training paradigms are compatible with the application: it is high when the paradigms leave enough room for strong agreement to emerge.
The combination of scores yields a simple phase diagram that distinguishes pairs worth using immediately from pairs that are budget-limited, ceiling-limited, or unlikely to succeed.
blocks.zh:
关键的想法是将兼容性分为两部分. 简单度量特定对是否已经开始关闭 : 当两个编码器在对齐或合并之前将相似的邻邻指定给相同的例子时, 它会很高 。 上限衡量相应的培训范式是否与应用兼容:当范式留下足够的空间来形成强烈的一致时,其水平很高.
分数的组合产生一个简单的相位图,将立即使用的对子与预算有限,上限有限,或不可能成功的对子区分开来.

blocks.en:
This two-axis view explains why the same model family can behave differently across applications.
Contrastive vision-language models are favorable for cross-modal alignment, where their pretraining objective is close to the downstream target, but unfavorable for task-arithmetic merging across classification tasks.
Discriminative and self-distillation models show the reverse pattern.
Thus, the relevant question is not whether a paradigm is universally good, but whether its objective is compatible with the transfer operation at hand.
blocks.zh:
这种两轴观点解释了为什么同一个模型家族在应用中的行为会有所不同.
相矛盾的视觉语言模型有利于跨模式的对齐,在这种模式中,其预训目标接近下游目标,但对跨分类任务的任务-算术合并却不利.
歧视性和自我分散模式呈现出相反的模式。
因此,相关问题不是一种模式是否普遍良好,而是其目标是否与目前的转让行动相容。

blocks.en: These conclusions are robust to both the composition of the model library and the precise estimation of the ceiling. Recomputing COMPASS while leaving out individual families or paradigms preserves correlations of 0.85 0.85 – 0.93 0.93 for alignment and 0.60 0.60 - 0.72 0.72 for merging on the remaining candidate pools ( Section H.8 ). Likewise, replacing pair-specific ceiling estimates with a single shared value per paradigm, or perturbing them with moderate noise, leaves the ranking largely unchanged, whereas shuffling the paradigm ordering removes this benefit ( Section H.10 ). The four regimes in our phase diagram should therefore be viewed as an interpretable summary rather than strict categories; for finer-grained comparisons, the continuous ease × \times ceiling score is more informative. We discuss further limitations of COMPASS in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 这些结论对于模型图书馆的组成和对上限的准确估计都是有力的。 比较COMPAS的同时,把个别家庭或范式排除在外,保留了0.85 0.85 – 0.93 0.93 和0.60 0.60 – 0.72 / 0.72 的关联性,用于合并其余候选人才库(H.8节)。 同样,用每个范式的单一共享价值取代特定对等上限估计数,或以中度噪音扰动这些估计数,使排名基本保持不变,而打乱范式则消除这一好处(H.10节)。 因此,我们阶段图中的四个制度应被视为一个可解释的概要,而不是严格的类别;对于更细微的比较,持续方便×x时间上限分数更能说明问题。 我们在附录A中进一步讨论了COMPAS的局限性。

blocks.en: COMPASS can help practitioners spend their compute budget where it is most likely to pay off. By ranking candidate pairs using only forward passes on a small probe set, it reduces the need to align or merge every possible combination. Its two-axis diagnostic also indicates whether to invest further in a pair or reconsider the pretraining paradigm. As pretrained model libraries grow, such inexpensive compatibility checks can make model selection more systematic and guide costly experiments toward the most promising combinations.
blocks.zh: COMPAS可以帮助从业者将其计算的预算花在最有可能得到回报的地方. 通过仅使用前传在小型探针集上进行排名的候选对子,减少了对齐或合并每一个可能组合的需要. 其双轴诊断还表明是进一步投资一对还是重新考虑预训模式. 随着训练有素的示范图书馆的发展,这种费用低廉的兼容性检查可以使模型选择更加系统化,并指导成本高昂的实验,实现最有希望的组合。

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: COMPASS might generalize to other domains involving interactions between two learned representations or models, but we leave such extensions to future work.
blocks.zh: COMPAS可能泛指涉及两个学到的表述或模型之间相互作用的其他领域,但我们将这种延伸留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: A second limitation concerns the definition of the ceiling proxy. In our experiments, we instantiate this score separately for the cross-modal alignment and for the task-arithmetic merging. More generally, the ceiling proxy depends on the application and requires domain-specific knowledge; it cannot be expressed as a single universal formula.
blocks.zh: 第二个限制涉及上限代用的定义。 在我们的实验中,我们分别将这个分数用于跨模式对齐和任务-数学合并. 更一般地说,上限代用依赖于应用,需要特定域的知识;它不能被表述为单一的普遍公式.

blocks.en: Our complete 72-pair cross-modal sweep uses CSA. To test whether the observed compatibility ranking is specific to this alignment procedure, we additionally evaluate trained Linear, MLP, and LoRA-style adapters on 24 representative pairs spanning all vision paradigms and find consistent pair rankings across alignment methods ( Section H.9 ).
blocks.zh: 我们完全的72帕跨模式扫描 使用CSA。 为了检验所观察到的兼容性排名是否是这一对齐程序所特有的,我们额外评价了经过训练的线性、MLP和LORA式适配器在24个具有代表性的对齐上横跨所有视觉范式,并发现一致的对齐排名跨对齐方法(H.9节)。

blocks.en: Our dynamical assumptions from Section 4.1 are sufficient conditions, not necessary ones, and may not hold for all training regimes. A2 is strongest when the training dynamics preserve the initial ordering of inter-encoder gaps and drive them down through a finite-time decay function λ ⁡ ( t ) \lambda(t) . For models with very different optimizers, data distributions, or objectives, this decay may be slow, yielding a loose bound. Section F.5 relaxes A2 to allow an additive noise floor that captures realistic SGD noise.
blocks.zh: 我们来自第4.1节的动态假设是充分的条件,而不是必要的条件,可能不适用于所有培训制度。 A2在训练动力学保留编码器间隙的初始定序,并通过限定时间衰变函数QQ( t)\lambda( t) 驱动下时最强. 对于具有非常不同的优化器,数据分布,或目标等模型,这种衰变可能缓慢,产生松散的束缚. F.5节放松A2,允许添加噪音底片捕捉现实的SGD噪声.

blocks.en: Finally, our phase diagram should be interpreted as a finite-budget diagnostic rather than an impossibility result. Pairs with low ease and low ceiling are predicted to be poor candidates under a fixed alignment or merging recipe and realistic compute and data budgets. However, with substantially more alignment data, larger adapters, longer training, or a different optimization objective, even pairs that are initially classified as incompatible may eventually achieve strong downstream performance. Thus, the proposed regimes describe the expected efficiency and practicality of transfer, not a fundamental impossibility claim.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的阶段图应被解释为一种有限的预算诊断,而不是不可能的结果。 低便捷和低上限的对等,在固定调整或合并配方以及现实计算和数据预算的情况下,预计是贫穷的候选人。 然而,随着比对数据大得多,适配器更大,训练时间更长,或者有不同的优化目标,即使是最初被归类为不兼容的对子,最终也可能实现强下游性能. 因此,拟议的制度描述了转让的预期效率和实用性,而不是根本不可能的索赔。

Model features are computed on a 1,024 1{,}024 -pair probe from WIT [ 26 ] , following Huh et al. [15] , for both the convergence and alignment experiment.

We evaluate mutual k k -NN overlap as a local metric and linear CKA as a global metric, both calibrated with the permutation procedure of Gröger et al. [16] , which controls for chance overlap by comparing the measured similarity against a null distribution from K = 200 K=200 random permutations of the embedding rows at significance level α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 .

blocks.en: B.1.1 Convergence library
blocks.zh: 第B.1.1条 汇合图书馆

blocks.en:
The convergence library contains 20 vision models and 17 language models.
The 20 vision models [ 31 ] span six paradigms: ImageNet-21K classification [ 32 ] with ViT-T/S/B/L [ 33 ] , masked autoencoders MAE-B/L/H [ 34 ] , DINOv2 self-distillation models at four scales (S/B/L/G, 35 ), CLIP-B/L/H [ 36 ] , CLIP-B/L/H fine-tuned on ImageNet-12K, and SigLIP-B/L/SO400M [ 37 ] .
The 17 language models span seven families: BLOOM at 560M to 7.1B parameters [ 38 ] , OpenLLaMA at 3B to 13B parameters [ 39 ] , the LLaMA family at 7B and 13B [ 40 ] together with Llama-3-8B [ 41 ] , OLMo at 1B and 7B parameters [ 42 ] , Gemma at 2B and 7B parameters [ 43 ] , Mistral at 7B parameters [ 44 ] , and the encoder model RoBERTa-large [ 45 ] .
The language panel spans heterogeneous architectural choices (ALiBi vs. RoPE positional encoding, multi-query vs. grouped-query vs. multi-head attention, sliding-window attention, RMSNorm vs. LayerNorm, GeGLU vs. SwiGLU activations), so the within- and across-family comparisons are not driven by a single dominant design.
For the initialization experiments we create three random variants per model with different seeds.
blocks.zh:
汇合库包含20种视觉模型和17种语言模型.
20种视觉模型[31]跨越6种范式:ImageNet-21K分类[32]与ViT-T/S/B/L[33],蒙面自动编码器MAE-B/L/H[34],DINov2在四个尺度上的自我消化模型(S/B/L/G,35),CLIP-B/L/H[36],CLIP-B/L/H在ImageNet-12K上的微调,以及SigLIP-B/L/SO400M[37].
17种语言模型跨越7个家族:BLOOM at 560M至7.1B参数 [38],OpenLLAMA at 3B至13B参数 [39],LLAMA家族 at 7B和13B [40] 连同Llama-3-8B [41],OLMo at 1B和7B参数 [42],Gemma at 2B和7B参数 [43],Mistral at 7B参数 [44],编码器模型RoBERTa-proad [45].
语言面板横跨不同的建筑选择(ALiBi vs. RoPE 位置编码,多query vs. 分组-query vs. 多头关注,滑窗关注,RMSNorm vs. LayerNorm, GeGLU vs. SwiGLU 激活),因此家族内部和跨家族的比较不是由单一主导设计驱动的.
在初始化实验中,我们创建了每个模型的三种随机变种,有不同的种子.

blocks.en: B.1.2 Alignment library
blocks.zh: B.1.2 对齐库

blocks.en:
The cross-modal alignment experiments use 19 vision models and 10 text encoders, evaluated on 72 vision-language pairs.
The vision side reuses the convergence library minus DINOv2-Giant, which is excluded because aligning a 1.1B-parameter encoder is too expensive for the per-pair adapter sweep.
The 10 text encoders span seven families: OLMo-1B/7B [ 42 ] , BLOOMz-560M/3B [ 38 ] , LLaMA-7B [ 40 ] , Mistral-7B [ 44 ] , RoBERTa-large [ 45 ] , and the text towers of CLIP-B/L [ 36 ] and SigLIP-B [ 37 ] .
blocks.zh:
跨模式对齐实验使用19个视觉模型和10个文本编码器,对72对视觉语言进行了评价.
视觉侧重用交汇库减DINOv2-Giant,由于对齐1.1B参数编码器对每个pair适配器的扫描费用太高,所以排除了.
10个文本编码器跨越7个家庭: OLMo-1B/7B [42],BLOOMz-560M/3B [38],LLAMA-7B [40],Mistral-7B [44],RoBERTA大 [45],以及CLIP-B/L [36]和SigLIP-B的文本塔 [37].

blocks.en:
The 72 pairs sample the 19 × 10 = 190 19\times 10=190 grid in a matchmaking design.
RoBERTa-large is paired with all 19 vision models, anchoring every vision scale and paradigm at one common text encoder.
The four base-size representatives of the four widest vision paradigms (ViT-21K-B, MAE-B, CLIP-B, SigLIP-B) are paired with all 10 text encoders, fully resolving the cross-paradigm overlap matrix at base scale.
Two further base-size representatives (DINOv2-B and CLIP-FT-B) are paired with 8 text encoders, omitting the LLaMA-7B and Mistral-7B columns.
DINOv2-L is paired with the four short-context text encoders only (RoBERTa-large and the three vision-language text towers).
Pairs in the intersection are counted once, summing to 72.
blocks.zh:
72对在配对设计中对19×10 = 190 19\times 10=190格栅进行取样.
RoBERTa大版与所有19种视觉模型配对,将每个视觉尺度和范式固定在一个共同的文本编码器上.
四大视野范式(ViT-21K-B,MAE-B,CLIP-B,SigLIP-B)的四个基数代表与全部10个文本编码器对齐,完全解决了基数尺度的跨参数重叠矩阵.
另外两个基数代表(DINOv2-B和CLIP-FT-B)与8个文本编码器对齐,省略了LLaMA-7B和Mistral-7B列.
DINOv2-L仅与四个短文本文本编码器(ROBERTa大和三个视觉语言文本塔)对齐.
十字路口的对价计算一次,即汇总为72.

blocks.en: B.1.3 Merging library
blocks.zh: B.1.3 合并图书馆

blocks.en:
The task-arithmetic merging experiments use a separate library of 14 ViT backbones loaded from public timm checkpoints [ 31 ] , chosen to match the standard task-arithmetic benchmark of Ilharco et al. [11] .
The 14 backbones span five paradigms: contrastive vision-language (CLIP-B-LAION, CLIP-B-OpenAI, SigLIP-B, CLIP-L-LAION), contrastive vision-language fine-tuned on classification (CLIP-FT-B, CLIP-FT-L), self-distillation (DINO-B [ 46 ] and DINOv3-B [ 47 ] ), reconstructive (MAE-B, MAE-L), and discriminative (ViT-T, two ViT-B variants from the augreg and orig recipes, and ViT-L, all on ImageNet-21K [ 32 ] ).
The self-distillation paradigm is represented by DINO and DINOv3 instead of DINOv2; the substitution is operational, since publicly available DINOv2 timm base checkpoints use patch14 while the rest of the merging base library is patch16.
blocks.zh:
任务-数学合并实验使用一个单独的图书馆,由14个从公共Timm检查站装载的ViT主干件组成[31],选取以与Ilharco等人的标准任务-数学基准相匹配. [11].
14个骨干跨越了五个范式:对比视觉语言(CLIP-B-LAION,CLIP-B-OpenAI,SigLIP-B,CLIP-L-LAION),对比视觉语言在分类上进行了微调(CLIP-FT-B,CLIP-FT-L),自我消化(DINO-B [46]和DINov3-B [47]),重建(MAE-B,MAE-L),以及区别对待(ViT-T,来自异构和异构食谱的两个ViT-B变体,以及ViT-L,全部在ImageNet-21K [32]).
自我消化模式由DINO和DINov3代表,而不是DINov2;这一替代是可操作的,因为公开的DINov2 Timm基地检查站使用补丁14,而合并基地库的其余部分为补丁16.

blocks.en: B.2 Cross-modal alignment protocol
blocks.zh: B.2 跨模式协调协议

blocks.en: We align each vision-language pair with CSA [ 25 ] , a closed-form adapter based on normalized canonical correlation analysis. Both encoders are kept frozen. The adapter consists of two linear projections that map the vision and language features into a shared 512 512 -dimensional canonical subspace, and is fitted in closed form by canonical correlation on paired image-caption embeddings. Since the solution is closed form, there is no iterative optimization and no learning rate, batch size, or epoch budget to set. We use a canonical dimension of 512 512 , no equal-weight constraint between the two projections, and no regularization on the canonical solution.
blocks.zh: 我们把每对视觉语言与CSA[25]对齐,一个基于规范的犬科关联分析的闭式适配器. 两个编码器都被冻结。 适配器由两个线性预测组成,将视觉和语言特征映射到一个共享的512 512 - 维的舟子空间,并在配对的图像封装嵌入上通过舟子的关联装配而成的封闭式. 由于溶液是封闭式的,因此没有迭代优化,也没有学习速率,批量大小,或者要设置划时代的预算. 我们使用512 512的方舟维度, 两个预测之间没有同等重量的限制, 也没有规范方舟解决方案。

blocks.en: For each pair, we select a single combination of one vision layer and one language layer. Following the layer-selection protocol of Gröger et al. [6] , we sample a probe of 5,000 5{,}000 paired image-caption embeddings from the MS-COCO 2014 training split [ 18 ] and choose the layer combination with the highest mutual k k -NN overlap at k = 10 k=10 . The canonical correlation is then fitted on paired image-caption embeddings from the MS-COCO 2014 training split at the selected layer combination. No augmentation is applied to the embeddings.
blocks.zh: 对于每对,我们选择一个视觉层和一个语言层的单一组合. 遵循格勒格等人的层选协议. [6],我们从MS-COCO 2014训练中抽取了5000 5{,}000对图像封装嵌入的探测器,分拆[18],并在k=10 k=10时选择与最高的相互k-NN重叠的层组合. 然后,在MS-COCO 2014培训的对映-封装嵌入物上安装了Cononical International,在选定的层组合中拆分。 嵌入体没有加固。

Recall@ 5 5 , Recall@ 10 10 , and the text-to-image direction are also computed but are not reported in the main paper. Retrieval uses cosine similarity between ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized aligned features with an evaluation batch size of 256 256 . Each pair is run once with a random seed of 42 42 . The closed-form solution is deterministic given its input features, so no additional seeds are required.

blocks.en: B.3 Task-arithmetic merging protocol
blocks.zh: B.3 任务-数学合并协议

blocks.en: Following the standard task-arithmetic benchmark of Ilharco et al. [11] , we use the eight image-classification tasks: MNIST, SVHN, GTSRB, DTD, EuroSAT, RESISC45, Stanford Cars, and SUN397. The 14 pretrained backbones are the merging library of Section B.1.3 . For every base model and every task we fine-tune one checkpoint, producing 14 × 8 = 112 14\times 8=112 task-specialized models in total.
blocks.zh: 按照伊尔哈科等人[11]的标准任务-数学基准,我们使用8个图像分类任务:MNIST,SVHN,GTSRB,DTD,EuroSAT,RESISC45,斯坦福汽车,和SUN397. 14个预训骨干是B.1.3节的合并库。 每个基建模式和每个任务,我们细化一个检查站,共生产14×8=112 14\时8=112任务专用模式.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning follows the standard end-to-end recipe in which all backbone parameters are updated together with the classifier head, with no frozen layers. We use AdamW [ 48 ] with weight decay 0.01 0.01 , the cross-entropy loss, and a cosine annealing schedule across the full training run [ 49 ] . The backbone learning rate is 10 − 4 10^{-4} . The classifier head is initialized at random, trained jointly with the backbone, and uses a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} (ten times the backbone rate). Each model is trained for 20 20 epochs with batch size 32 32 , and the final-epoch checkpoint is used for all subsequent merging and evaluation. Training images are augmented with a random resized crop of size 224 224 at scale 0.6 0.6 to 1.0 1.0 , followed by a random horizontal flip and ImageNet normalization. Evaluation images are resized to 256 256 pixels on the short side, center-cropped to 224 224 , and ImageNet-normalized. The random seed is fixed at 42 42 across all fine-tuning runs.
blocks.zh: 精细调整遵循标准端到端配方,其中所有主干参数与分类符头一起更新,无冷冻层. 我们使用 AdamW [48] 的重量衰减 0.01 0.01, 交叉进化损失, 和 共心反射时间表 整个训练运行 [49] 。 骨干学习率为10~4 10~4}. 分类员头部随机初始化,与骨干共同训练,采用10~3 10~3}的学习率(骨干率的十倍). 每个型号为20个20个世纪,批量大小32 32 个,最后的时代检查站用于所有后续的合并和评价. 培训图像被放大,随机调整尺寸为224 224,规模为0.6至1.0 1.0,然后随机横向翻转和ImageNet正常化。 评估图像在短侧被调整为256,256像素,中缩为224,224,图像网被规范化. 随机种子被固定为42 42 在所有微调运行。

blocks.en: Merging follows the standard task-arithmetic recipe of Ilharco et al. [11] , which averages fine-tuned weights in the spirit of model soups [ 7 ] . For pairwise merging, two fine-tuned checkpoints of the same backbone are combined by averaging their backbone weights, θ merged = 0.5 ​ θ a + 0.5 ​ θ b \theta_{\text{merged}}=0.5\,\theta_{a}+0.5\,\theta_{b} . The classifier head from each task is restored at evaluation time, so that the merged backbone is paired with the original task-specific head when scoring that task. For the multi-task task-arithmetic extension reported in Section H.4 , the merged backbone is θ base + α ​ ∑ i ( θ i − θ base ) \theta_{\text{base}}+\alpha\sum_{i}(\theta_{i}-\theta_{\text{base}}) across all eight tasks, with α ∈ { 0.3 , 0.5 } \alpha\in\{0.3,0.5\} , also following Ilharco et al. [11] .

blocks.en: B.5 Compute resources
blocks.zh: B.5 计算资源

blocks.en: All experiments run on a cluster of 8 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPUs (24 GB each), with each individual training run scheduled to a single GPU. Per-run memory is below 4 GB, and per-run wall time is at most 30 minutes. The total compute budget across all reported experiments is approximately 100 GPU-hours, including the 72 cross-modal alignment runs, the 112 fine-tuning runs that produce the merging checkpoints, and the forward passes used to compute k k -NN overlap and CKA across the model library.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都运行在由8个NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPU(每组24GB)组成的集群上,每个单个训练都安排在一个GPU上. 每台运行的内存低于4GB,每台运行的墙壁时间最多为30分钟. 所有报告实验的计算总预算约为100GPU小时,包括72次跨模式对齐运行,112次产生合并检查站的微调运行,以及用于计算k-NN重叠和CKA跨模式库的前进通道。

blocks.en: Appendix C Broader impact
blocks.zh: 附录C 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: COMPASS is a measurement framework for selecting model pairs before alignment or merging. It introduces no new pretrained models, releases no scraped data, and does not change the capabilities of any existing system. Its intended use is to reduce the wasted compute spent on transferring incompatible model pairs, which we view as a net positive for accessibility and energy use. We do not foresee direct negative societal impacts beyond those already associated with the underlying pretrained models, which are released by their original authors under their stated licenses.
blocks.zh: COMPAS是用于在对齐或合并之前选择模型配对的测量框架. 它没有引入新的预先训练过的模型,没有发布报废数据,也没有改变任何现有系统的能力。 它的预期用途是减少在转移不相容的模型对时浪费的计算,我们认为这对无障碍和能源使用来说是净正数。 我们没有预见到除了那些已经与事先受过训练的基本模式有关的社会直接负面影响,这些模式是由原作者根据所宣称的许可证发布的。

blocks.en: Appendix D Why local: empirical evidence
blocks.zh: 附录D 当地原因:经验证据

blocks.en: This experiment motivates the choice of local k k -NN overlap rather than global CKA as the cheap-to-compute proxy used in Section 5 . Local neighborhood recovery is a strictly weaker requirement than global distance recovery, so local metrics can track alignment trends in regimes where global metrics flatten or diverge. For each fixed reference model, we correlate calibrated alignment with the partner model’s scale (parameter count).
blocks.zh: 这一实验激励选择本地 k k - NN 重叠,而不是全球 CKA 作为第5节中使用的廉价到计算代用. 与全球距离恢复相比,地方邻里恢复是一项极为薄弱的要求,因此,在那些全球衡量标准趋于平缓或不一致的制度中,地方衡量标准可以跟踪调整趋势。 对于每个固定的参考模型,我们把校准调整与伙伴模型的尺度(参数计数)联系起来。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Pearson r r between calibrated alignment and model scale ( k = 10 k=10 ), for each fixed reference model. Left: for cross-modal, local k k -NN (green) shows positive scaling (mean r ≈ 0.64 r\approx 0.64 ), while global CKA (blue) is weaker after calibration (mean r ≈ 0.37 r\approx 0.37 ). blocks.en: Theorem 4.2 uses KL divergences, which require full-support distributions. The ε \varepsilon -smoothing in Equation 3 mixes the hard distribution with the uniform background and yields a full-support conditional, while Proposition E.2 preserves the hard-overlap semantics exactly up to the factor ( 1 − ε ) (1-\varepsilon) . The smoothing parameter ε \varepsilon is a fixed analytical regularizer required only to make KL divergences finite. In practice we take ε \varepsilon small ( e.g. , ε = 1 / N \varepsilon=1/N ), which keeps the prefactor 1 / ( 1 − ε ) 1/(1-\varepsilon) in Theorem 4.2 close to 1 1 at the cost of larger KL terms when supports of the learned and target distributions disagree. A natural alternative is to replace the hard distribution with a distance-based soft distribution ( e.g. , a Gaussian over embedding distances). We avoid this choice because such distributions implicitly assume that local metric distances are meaningful objects of comparison across views. The empirical object of interest, hard k k -NN overlap, depends only on neighbor identity and not on the distances to those neighbors. The ε \varepsilon -smoothing preserves this property by adding uniform background mass to all non-self indices regardless of their distances, while providing the full support required for KL divergences to be finite.

G.2 A natural shared target

blocks.en: Theorem 4.2 holds for any pair of full-support targets. One natural setting where γ i = 0 \gamma_{i}=0 is when both encoders observe paired views of the same underlying content ( e.g. , an image and its caption): a conditional affinity distribution p ⋆ ​ ( j ∣ i ) ∝ κ ⁡ ( i , j ) , j ≠ i , p^{\star}(j\mid i)\propto\kappa(i,j),\hskip 18.49988ptj\neq i, (30) serves as a shared target, where κ ⁡ ( i , j ) \kappa(i,j) measures co-occurrence or affinity between paired contents and is therefore independent of the view. For instance, when pairs arise under an unobserved context variable, κ ⁡ ( i , j ) \kappa(i,j) is proportional to the expected co-occurrence of the two contents under that context, which is compatible with contrastive views of representation learning [ 50 ] . Smoothing this candidate via q ⋆ ( ε ) ( j ∣ i ) := ( 1 − ε ) p ⋆ ( j ∣ i ) + ε N − 1 1 { j ≠ i } q_{\star}^{(\varepsilon)}(j\mid i):=(1-\varepsilon)\,p^{\star}(j\mid i)+\frac{\varepsilon}{N-1}\,\mathbbm{1}\{j\neq i\} (31) yields a full-support target suitable for Theorem 4.2 . blocks.en: The unimodal panels of Figure 2 use the initial random k k -NN overlap o i ( 0 ) o_{i}^{(0)} as a start-condition proxy for Theorem 4.1 . For the proxy to be well-posed, three things must hold at initialization: (i) two copies of the same randomly initialized model should agree on their local geometry (random seeds of the same architecture give a meaningful family-level δ i ( 0 ) \delta_{i}^{(0)} ), (ii) models from different families should disagree more (architecture modulates δ i ( 0 ) \delta_{i}^{(0)} ), and (iii) training must actually change local geometry (otherwise the final-vs-initial correlation would be a tautology). Figures 7(a) and 7(b) verify all three for vision and text respectively.
