blocks.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it. The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
blocks.zh: 报告1-西格玛错误栏是正常的,但应该说明这一点。 如果错误的正常性假设没有得到核实,提交人最好报告2-西格玛错误栏,而不是说他们有96%的CI。

blocks.en: For asymmetric distributions, the authors should be careful not to show in tables or figures symmetric error bars that would yield results that are out of range (e.g., negative error rates).
blocks.zh: 对于不对称分布,作者应注意不要在表格或数字对称误差栏中显示会产生超出范围的结果(如负误差率).

blocks.en: If error bars are reported in tables or plots, the authors should explain in the text how they were calculated and reference the corresponding figures or tables in the text.
blocks.zh: 如果在表格或图中报告错误栏,作者应在文字中解释它们是如何计算的,并在文字中参考相应的数字或表格。

blocks.en: Experiments compute resources
blocks.zh: 计算资源

blocks.en: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
blocks.zh: 问题: 对于每个实验,论文是否提供了复制实验所需的计算机资源(计算工人的类型,内存,执行时间)的充分信息?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: Yes, Section B.5 reports GPU type, memory, per-run wall time, per-run memory use, and the approximate total compute budget for the reported experiments.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 是的,B.5节报告GPU类型,内存,每运行的墙壁时间,每运行的内存使用,以及报告实验的大约总计算预算.

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments. • The paper should indicate the type of compute workers CPU or GPU, internal cluster, or cloud provider, including relevant memory and storage. • The paper should provide the amount of compute required for each of the individual experimental runs as well as estimate the total compute. • The paper should disclose whether the full research project required more compute than the experiments reported in the paper (e.g., preliminary or failed experiments that didn’t make it into the paper).
blocks.zh: • 答案[N/A]是指论文不包括实验。 纸张应说明计算工人的CPU或GPU、内部集群或云提供商的类型,包括相关的内存和存储。 文件应提供每次试验所需的计算数额,并估计计算总额。 论文应披露完整的研究项目是否比论文中报告的实验需要更多的计算(例如初步或失败的实验,这些实验没有把它写进论文中).

blocks.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments.
blocks.zh: 答案[n/A]表示论文不包括实验.

blocks.en: The paper should indicate the type of compute workers CPU or GPU, internal cluster, or cloud provider, including relevant memory and storage.
blocks.zh: 纸张应注明计算工人的CPU或GPU,内部集群,或云提供商的类型,包括相关的内存和存储.

blocks.en: The paper should provide the amount of compute required for each of the individual experimental runs as well as estimate the total compute.
blocks.zh: 文件应提供每次试验所需的计算数额以及估计的总计算数额。

blocks.en: The paper should disclose whether the full research project required more compute than the experiments reported in the paper (e.g., preliminary or failed experiments that didn’t make it into the paper).
blocks.zh: 论文应披露完整的研究项目是否比论文中报告的实验需要更多的计算(例如初步或失败的实验,这些实验没有把它写进论文中).

blocks.en: Code of ethics
blocks.zh: 道德守则

blocks.en: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ?
blocks.zh: 问题: 本文所进行的研究是否在各个方面都符合《新教IPS道德守则》(https://neurips.cc/public/Ethics Guidelines)?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: Yes, the authors have carefully reviewed and adhered to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 是的,提交人认真审查和遵守了《新IPS道德守则》。

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the authors have not reviewed the NeurIPS Code of Ethics. • If the authors answer [No] , they should explain the special circumstances that require a deviation from the Code of Ethics. • The authors should make sure to preserve anonymity (e.g., if there is a special consideration due to laws or regulations in their jurisdiction).
blocks.zh: • 答案[N/A]意味着作者没有审查《新IPS道德守则》。 如果作者回答[否],他们应该解释需要偏离道德守则的特殊情况。 提交人应确保匿名(例如,如果由于其管辖范围内的法律或条例受到特别考虑)。

blocks.en: The answer [N/A] means that the authors have not reviewed the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.
blocks.zh: 答案[N/A]表示作者没有审查过NeurIPS道德守则.

blocks.en: If the authors answer [No] , they should explain the special circumstances that require a deviation from the Code of Ethics.
blocks.zh: 如果作者回答[否],他们应当解释需要偏离道德守则的特殊情况。

blocks.en: The authors should make sure to preserve anonymity (e.g., if there is a special consideration due to laws or regulations in their jurisdiction).
blocks.zh: 提交人应确保匿名(例如,如果由于其管辖范围内的法律或条例受到特别考虑)。

blocks.en: Broader impacts
blocks.zh: 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否讨论了所开展工作的潜在积极社会影响和消极社会影响?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: Yes, the positive societal impact of the paper is discussed in Section 1 , Section 5 , and Section 6 and broader impact is discussed in Appendix C . Negative societal impacts are not expected as the outlined diagnostics tends to reduce wasted compute in model transfer experiments.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 是的,第1节第5节和第6节讨论了该文件的正面社会影响,附录C讨论了更广泛的影响。 预计不会产生消极的社会影响,因为概述的诊断往往减少模型转移实验中浪费的计算。

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that there is no societal impact of the work performed. • If the authors answer [N/A] or [No] , they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact. • Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations. • The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster. • The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology. • If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML).
blocks.zh: · 答案[N/A]是指所进行的工作没有社会影响。 如果作者回答[N/A]或[否],他们应当解释他们的工作为何没有社会影响,或为何文件没有涉及社会影响。 • 支助 负面社会影响的例子包括潜在的恶意或意外使用(例如:造谣、制造假面貌、监视)、公平考虑(例如:采用可能作出对特定群体造成不公平影响的决定的技术)、隐私考虑和安全考虑。 会议期望许多论文将是基础研究,而不是与特定应用挂钩,更不用说部署. 然而,如果有任何否定性申请的直接途径,提交人应当指出。 例如,可以合理地指出,可以利用基因模型质量的提高来产生用于造谣的Deepfakes. 另一方面,不需要指出优化神经网络的通用算法可以让人们训练出更快生成Deepfake的模型. ^ . 作者应考虑在技术作为预期和正确使用时可能产生的伤害,在技术作为预期使用时可能产生的伤害,但产生不正确的结果,以及(有意或无意)滥用技术造成的伤害。 如果存在负面的社会影响,作者还可以讨论可能的缓解战略(例如,对模型进行封闭释放,在攻击之外提供防御,监测误用的机制,监测系统如何从反馈中吸取教训的机制,提高ML的效率和可获取性)。

blocks.en: The answer [N/A] means that there is no societal impact of the work performed.
blocks.zh: 答案[N/A]意味着已完成的工作没有社会影响。

blocks.en: If the authors answer [N/A] or [No] , they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact.
blocks.zh: 如果作者回答[N/A]或[否],他们应当解释他们的工作为何没有社会影响,或为何文件没有涉及社会影响。

For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.

blocks.en: Safeguards
blocks.zh: 保障措施

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否描述了为负责任地发布具有高度滥用风险的数据或模型(如预先培训的语言模型、图像生成器或报废数据集)而实施的保障措施?

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A]
blocks.zh: 答复:[不详]

blocks.en: Justification: This paper poses no such risks as beyond code we are not releasing any new artifacts such as data or models.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 本文没有带来任何风险,除了代码之外,我们没有释放任何新的文物,如数据或模型。

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper poses no such risks. • Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters. • Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images. • We recognize that providing effective safeguards is challenging, and many papers do not require this, but we encourage authors to take this into account and make a best faith effort.
blocks.zh: 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件没有构成这种风险。 • 释放的具有高度滥用或双重用途风险的模型,应附带必要的保障措施,允许控制使用该模型,例如要求用户遵守使用准则或限制进入模型或实施安全过滤器。 • 支助 从互联网上拆掉的数据集可能构成安全风险。 作者应说明如何避免释放不安全的图像。 我们认识到,提供有效的保障是一项挑战,许多文件并不要求这样做,但我们鼓励作者考虑到这一点,并作出最大的诚意努力。

blocks.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper poses no such risks.
blocks.zh: 答案[N/A]是指该文件没有构成这种风险。

blocks.en: Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters.
blocks.zh: 释放的具有高度滥用或双重用途风险的模型应附带必要的保障措施,允许控制地使用模型,例如要求用户遵守使用准则或限制进入模型或实施安全过滤器。

blocks.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
blocks.zh: 从互联网上拆掉的数据集可能构成安全风险。 提交人应说明他们如何避免释放不安全的图像。

blocks.en: Licenses for existing assets
blocks.zh: 现有资产的许可证

blocks.en: Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
blocks.zh: 问题: 纸上是否使用资产(例如代码、数据、模型)的创造者或原始所有人,是否适当贷记,许可证和使用条款是否明确提及和适当遵守?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: Yes, the paper cites the pretrained models and datasets used in the experiments, and Section B.6 lists the datasets together with their licenses or terms of use.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 是,该文件列举了试验中使用的预先训练过的模型和数据集,B.6节列出了数据集及其许可证或使用条件。

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not use existing assets. • The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset. • The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL. • The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset. • For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided. • If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided. For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets. Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset. • For existing datasets that are re-packaged, both the original license and the license of the derived asset (if it has changed) should be provided. • If this information is not available online, the authors are encouraged to reach out to the asset’s creators.
blocks.zh: • 答案[N/A]是指该文件不使用现有资产。 作者应引述产生代码包或数据集的原始文件。 作者应说明使用哪个版本的资产,并在可能的情况下包括一个URL。 许可证名称(如CC-BY 4.0)应包含每项资产。 • 支助 对于从某一特定来源(如网站)提取的数据,应当提供该来源的版权和服务条件。 资产放行的,应当提供许可证,著作权信息,包件中的使用条件. 对于流行的数据集来说,使用code.com/dataset的文档拥有一些数据集的许可证。 它们的许可证指南有助于确定一个数据集的许可证。 • 支助 对于重新包装的现有数据集,应提供原始许可证和衍生资产的许可证(如果已经改变)。 如果这种信息不在网上提供,则鼓励作者接触资产的创造者。

blocks.en: New assets
blocks.zh: 新资产

blocks.en: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件中介绍的新资产是否有详细记录,是否与资产一起提供文件?

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A]
blocks.zh: 答复:[不详]

blocks.en: Justification: This paper does not release any new assets beyond the code, which is adequately documented in order to reproduce all the results from the paper.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 本文除代码外不放出任何新资产,该代码有充分的记载,以复制该文件的所有结果.

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not release new assets. • Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates. This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc. • The paper should discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose asset is used. • At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable). You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.
blocks.zh: 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件不释放新资产。 • 研究人员应通过结构化模板,将数据集/代码/模型的细节作为提交材料的一部分。 • 培训、许可证、限制等细节 该文件应讨论是否以及如何获得资产被使用者的同意。 在提交时,请记住对您的资产进行匿名(如果适用)。 您可以创建一个匿名的 URL 或包含一个匿名的 zip 文件 。

blocks.en: Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects
blocks.zh: 与人类学科的群包和研究

blocks.en: Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?
blocks.zh: 问题: 关于众包实验和与人类主体的研究,论文是否包括提供给参与者的指示全文和(如果适用的话)截图,以及(如果有)补偿的细节?

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A]
blocks.zh: 答复:[不详]

blocks.en: Justification: The paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 论文不涉及众包,也不涉及人类主体的研究.

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects. • Including this information in the supplemental material is fine, but if the main contribution of the paper involves human subjects, then as much detail as possible should be included in the main paper. • According to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics, workers involved in data collection, curation, or other labor should be paid at least the minimum wage in the country of the data collector.
